description: Land Acquisition - Enasalmada, Ukuwela D/S Division, Matale Division
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire a plot of land (Enasalmada watta) for a public purpose (alternative land for people displaced due to heavy rain and landslides). The content focuses entirely on land acquisition details including property description, location, extent, and compensation procedures, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification system.
